The specific quantification and product naming materially changes the substance of the growth drivers disclosed.

comparisons.peer_summary: International sales accounted for 66% of net revenue in 2024 (65% in 2023) and are expected to remain significant; substantially all sales transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies discuss the concentration or composition of their revenue sources in their Results of Operations, though they focus on different dimensions. NVDA discloses that demand is concentrated within a specific product segment (Compute & Networking), implying dependency on specific high-growth areas. In contrast, AMD discloses the geographic concentration of its sales, noting that international sales represented 66% of net revenue and are expected to remain significant, without mentioning product-level concentration in this specific disclosure.

sentences.text: Our estimated Compute & Networking demand is expected to remain concentrated.
International sales as a percentage of net revenue were 66% in 2024 and 65% in 2023.
We expect that international sales will continue to be a significant portion of total sales in the foreseeable future.

comparisons.peer_summary: Semiconductor solutions segment net revenue increased due to strong demand for AI networking products, partially offset by lower demand for broadband and server storage. Infrastructure software segment net revenue increased primarily due to contributions from VMware.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AVGO explicitly attribute revenue growth and demand concentration to AI networking products within their semiconductor segments. NVDA states that estimated Compute & Networking demand remains concentrated, which aligns with AVGO's disclosure that semiconductor solutions segment net revenue increased due to 'strong product demand for our networking products, primarily AI networking products.' Both highlight AI networking as a primary driver of their respective revenue performance in the 2024 fiscal year.

sentences.text: Our estimated Compute & Networking demand is expected to remain concentrated.

Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased due to strong product demand for our networking products, primarily AI networking products, partially offset by lower demand for our broadband and server storage products.

peer_results.rationale: The supplied candidates (intc_2024_7_D032 and intc_2024_7_D029) discuss product offerings (NICs, IPUs) and feature sets for cloud and edge networking, rather than revenue concentration, demand patterns, or financial drivers of segment performance. NVDA's disclosure is specifically about the concentration of estimated demand, not product features.

The supplied candidates (mu_2024_7_D052 and mu_2024_7_D051) cover revenue recognition policies and property impairment accounting, respectively. These are accounting methodology disclosures unrelated to NVDA's discussion of market demand concentration in the Compute & Networking segment.

The supplied candidates (qcom_2024_7_D025 and qcom_2024_7_D007) detail drivers for QTL licensing revenue increases, specifically citing multimode product sales volumes and pricing. This is a mobile-centric licensing business model, distinct from NVDA's hardware and networking demand concentration narrative.
